mapper.select: select previous_consent_id from roam_presence_revoke_intent where member_id=#{memberId} and event_type='AGREE' order by id desc limit 1 for update
mapper.update: update roam_presence_revoke_intent set state=1,owner_token=#{ownerToken}, lease_until=date_add(now(6),interval 120 second),attempt_count=attempt_count+1 where request_id=#{requestId} and event_type='REVOKE' and attempt_count < 3 and ((state=0 and next_attempt_at <= now(6)) or (state=1 and lease_until <= now(6)))
update roam_presence_revoke_intent set state=2,owner_token=null,lease_until=null where request_id=#{requestId} and state=1 and owner_token=#{ownerToken}
update roam_presence_revoke_intent set state=3,owner_token=null,lease_until=null where request_id=#{requestId} and state=1 and lease_until <= now(6) and attempt_count >= 3
